#include<cstdio>
#include<algorithm>
#include<cstring>
#include<cmath>
#define rep(i,a,b) for(i=a;i<=b;i++)
using namespace std;
const int N=300010;
int n,K,mod;
int dp[N],cnt[N],mx[N],cj[N],inv[N];

int power(int x,int y){
	int ret=1;
	for(;y;y>>=1,x=1ll*x*x%mod){
		if(y&1)	ret=1ll*ret*x%mod;
	}
	return ret;
}

int C(int i,int j){
	return 1ll*cj[i]*inv[j]%mod*inv[i-j]%mod;
}

int main(){
	scanf("%d%d%d",&n,&K,&mod);
	if(n&1){printf("%d\n",power(K,n));return 0;}
	cj[0]=1;rep(i,1,n)	cj[i]=1ll*cj[i-1]*i%mod;
	inv[n]=power(cj[n],mod-2);inv[0]=1;
	for(i=n-1;i;i--)	inv[i]=1ll*inv[i+1]*(i+1)%mod;
	rep(i,1,n)
		rep(j,0,18)
			if(1<<j&i)	cnt[i]++;
	dp[0]=1;
	rep(i,1,n){
		if((n&i)!=i)	continue;
		for(k=0;k<=i;k++){
			cur1=k+mx[i];cur2=i^cur1;
			up=min(K-1,cnt[cur2]);
			tmp=C(i,cur1);	
			dp[i]=(dp[i]+1ll*dp[cur2]*tmp)%mod;						
			if(k==0)	break;
		}
	}
	rep(j,1,min(cnt[n],K))	dp[n]=(dp[n]+1ll*dp[n]*C(K,j)%mod*cj[j])%mod;
	ans=(power(K,n)-dp[n]+mod)%mod;
	printf("%d\n",ans);
	return 0;
}
